entities.name: Jean Alix Verrier
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alix Verrier was a Haitian Roman Catholic prelate. He served as Bishop of Les Cayes from 1988 to 2009. Verrier died in Port-au-Prince on 11 October 2024, at the age of 93.
